    ProblemDetail:

        firstName:

          title: Last name

          type: string

          type: string

          maxLength: 255

        addressLine2:

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          maxLength: 80

          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'

              readOnly: true

              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|H-1A2B3C4D'

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:

              description: "IANA timezone name derived from the region via a fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane)."

              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true

              description: "True once more than 80 owners have already been created today, otherwise false."

              default: false
              example: false

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:

              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
          required:
